datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ5221B THRU MMSZ5267B SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: MMSZ5259B VZ range at IZT = 0.0032 A is 37.05 V minimum, 39.00 V nominal, and 40.95 V maximum at TA = 25 degC.
MMSZ5259B maximum zener impedance is 800 ohm at IZ = 0.00025 A, as stated by the ZZT@IZT=0.25mA column heading.
The zener and capacitance plots are family-level typical curves; plotted points are manual digitizations and are not guaranteed limits.
extraction.omission_reason: Reverse-recovery data is not published. The capacitance value is available only from a family-level typical plot, not a part-specific table.
